ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BC=6\,cm$, $BD=7\,cm$, $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$, find the length of $AB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $BC=6\,\text{cm}$ and $BD=7\,\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore CD=BD-BC=1\,\text{cm}$,\\
Since point $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
$\therefore AD=CD=1\,\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore AB=AD+BD=1+7=\boxed{8}\,\text{cm}$.
